hooks.command: f=$(cat | grep -o '"file_path"[^,}]*' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/'); norm=$(printf '%s' "$f" | sed 's/\\\\/\//g'); case "$norm" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$norm" in *frontend/*) exe="D:/PROJECTS/envelo/frontend/.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe" ;; *services/api-gateway/*) exe="D:/PROJECTS/envelo/services/api-gateway/.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; "$exe" check --fix --quiet "$norm" 2>/dev/null || true
